messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager | P95 latency spike for /v1/generate (prod-us-west) - 75% error rate, autoscaler not scaling.
Alex K: I'm on it. seeing increased queue length on embed-frontend.
Alex K: paging infra & sres, marking as sev2. @Priya M can you take lead for triage?
Priya M: taking lead. grabbing logs now. any customer-facing alerts?
Sara L: CS reporting 2 customers saw 500s on chat endpoints, ticket 7892 opened.
Marc D: looking at allocator metrics — GPU pool A hitting 100% mem, OOMs across 3 nodes.
Priya M: pattern: new large-chat workloads caused long sequences, memory retention grew because kv-cache items not evicted. suspect KV cache policy regression from last deploy.
Incident Bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T02:14:22Z to service embed-serve was rolled out 18m ago.
Alex K: rollback to previous revision? safe fallback?
Marc D: we can revert the kv-cache change quickly. prepping rollback patch.
Priya M: mitigation plan: 1) enable autoscaler force-scale + add eviction flag 2) route traffic away from pool A -> pool B (lower latency) 3) roll back kv-cache change if memory doesn't stabilize.
Alex K: I’ll do routing. @Marc D coordinate rollback. Priya, watch errors and customer impact.
Marc D: rollback applied to embed-serve v2.9.5 -> v2.9.4. patch commands:
```
kubectl set image deploy/embed-serve embed-serve=redwood/embed-serve:v2.9.4 -n prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/embed-serve -n prod
```
Priya M: errors dropping to ~6% now, queue length reducing. memory on nodes freeing up.
Sara L: CS: impacted customers notified with temporary mitigation message. no new escalations.
Alex K: good. Marking live mitigation complete. setting follow-up postmortem. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: Live mitigation complete at 1768435600. Incident ticket INC-2026-045 created.
Alex K: Post-incident: schedule postmortem and capture timeline + RCA. Who can own the write-up?
Priya M: I can start the timeline and technical RCA. Marc can add infra notes. Sara can add customer impact notes and verbatim CS messages.
Marc D: will add rollout changes and the kv-cache PR link. putting action items inline.
Nitya R: product wants summary for affected SLAs and customers; will own follow-up comms.
Alex K: ok owners assigned. Proposed postmortem slot: Thu 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Anyone blocked?
Priya M: works for me.
Sara L: works.
Marc D: works.
Nitya R: works.
Alex K: action items (short):
- "Add evict-by-age to KV cache and feature-flag it" — owner: Marc D — due: 2026-03-26
- "Add load test for long-sequence chat (>=8k tokens) into nightly harness" — owner: Priya M — due: 2026-03-24
- "Create customer impact summary and update affected accounts" — owner: Sara L — due: 2026-03-21
- "Adjust autoscaler thresholds to scale more aggressively for queue length spikes" — owner: Alex K — due: 2026-03-22
- "Add regression test to CI that runs kv-cache stress scenario" — owner: Marc D — due: 2026-03-29
- "Prepare product-facing postmortem blurb" — owner: Nitya R — due: 2026-03-21
Priya M: I'll also add an alert tweak: reduce the 'stale-kv' silence window to 5m to fire earlier.
Alex K: please add ticket IDs for each action item in the doc. we'll track in INC-2026-045.
Incident Bot: Postmortem meeting scheduled: 1768711200 (Thu 2026-03-19T17:00:00Z). Calendar invite sent.
Alex K: Org learning: propose a brown-bag to walk through the KV cache design, how sequence length affects memory, and the autoscaler knobs. good for infra/eng-sre/eng-runtime.
Nitya R: agreed — product & solutions should join. propose Wed 2026-03-25 15:00 PT. 60 min.
Sara L: include sample CS language and playbook for customer comms.
Priya M: want to include a demo of the stress test and how to run it locally.
Marc D: will prepare slides on recent kv-cache PRs, metrics to watch, and a small runbook for emergency routing.
Alex K: cool. owners for brown-bag prep: Marc D (slides + runbook), Priya M (stress test demo), Nitya R (audience + invite), Sara L (CS playbook). deliverables due one week before the session.
Priya M: putting preliminary RCA notes in the incident doc: https://redwood-internal/INC-2026-045 (will update with logs and flamegraphs).
Nitya R: I'll draft the product blurb and link to the postmortem.
Sara L: CS will follow up with the two impacted customers tomorrow EOD.
Alex K: final checklist before closing incident thread:
- postmortem doc link in ticket (Priya)
- action items created with owners & dates (Marc & Alex)
- brown-bag scheduled and calendar invites (Nitya)
- customer comms updated (Sara)
Once those are done, we can close INC-2026-045 and run the retro.
Priya M: noted. will have first-pass RCA by EOD tomorrow.
Marc D: creating infra tickets now.
Sara L: CS follow-ups scheduled.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-045 marked 'mitigated' at 1768439200. Awaiting postmortem.
Alex K: thanks team. we'll capture prevention patterns: eviction-first designs, autoscaler ops runbooks, and improve testing for extreme sequences. planning a short retro in the postmortem meeting.
Nitya R: thanks all. we'll make the brown-bag inclusive and record it.
Alex K: thread will stay open for any late items. closing live thread for now. :lock:
